editorial:
Two rival figure skaters get banned from singles competition after a wild on-ice fight, but they find a loophole that lets them compete together as a pairs team. That is the wild setup of this comedy, and it works better than you might expect. Will Ferrell plays Chazz Michael Michaels, a flashy, over-the-top skater, while Jon Heder plays Jimmy MacElroy, a graceful, uptight rival. Their forced partnership creates instant comedy as two very different personalities try to work together on the ice. The movie leans into absurd humor, silly costumes, and ridiculous skating routines that keep you laughing from start to finish.

The acting is solid, especially Ferrell's commitment to his ridiculous character. The pacing moves quickly, and the skating scenes are surprisingly fun to watch. On the downside, some jokes feel a bit repetitive, and the plot is pretty thin. Still, if you enjoy silly sports comedies, this one delivers. It is great for a relaxed movie night with friends. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or pick up the 4K Blu-ray for your collection.
endingExplained: In the final competition, Chazz and Jimmy perform their routine while their rivals, the Van Waldenberg siblings, try to sabotage them. The siblings' plan backfires, and Chazz and Jimmy land their big move, the Iron Lotus, which had previously caused serious injuries. They win the gold medal, and the movie ends with them celebrating their unlikely victory and friendship. The twist is that their dangerous signature move actually works this time, proving their partnership was worth the risk.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves silly sports comedies and Will Ferrell movies.
